text: The hotel receptionist recommended the clinic to us when my partner cracked his tooth. Dr Yossawat was friendly and caring.  He also showed great professionalism when assessed and mended my partner's tooth. I decided to opt for a dental checkup and was  pleased with the results.  Would visit again on my next visit.
my favorite doctor in Bangkok

A small dental clinic...that I've been going to regularly for over 10 years. The clinic is clean (you have to take off your shoes before entering).
The doctor graduated from Chulalongkorn University...is friendly, the dental work is painless, and the prices are affordable.
You can call to make an appointment in advance.
It's located opposite Taksin Hospital, near the Khlong San station of the Gold Line.

This is a clinic that our family has been going to since my father's generation. The prices are friendly and the doctors are kind. I highly recommend it. We always recommend and tell others about it because the treatment is targeted and doesn't lead to unforeseen costs.
The tooth extraction was very gentle and quick. The dentist was very kind.

I just had a tooth extracted 15 minutes ago.
I rinsed my mouth three times when I entered the clinic. They injected the local anesthetic, which felt like a mosquito bite. After the injection, I didn't feel any pain at all, even though I thought it would. It would be like the pain you feel after eating, but I didn't feel anything. The extraction was very quick, less than 10 minutes. Good service, and the price was cheap, under 1000 baht. I recommend it, it's great.

text:
The dentist was very gentle. Before I could even prepare myself, he said it was already done. The price was very cheap. Why did I only just find such a good clinic?
I highly recommend this place for tooth extractions.

The doctor made a quick decision, had a gentle hand, and did tooth extraction and tartar removal without any pain. The price was very reasonable, cheaper than other shops, and the quality was excellent.
Attentive, gentle touch, and helpful advice. Thank you.
The doctor gave excellent advice. Our whole family receives treatment from this doctor, and they are all very gentle.

The clinic is clean, the dentist seems experienced, and gives very straightforward advice. I went for a filling and the dentist was very gentle; it was a very comfortable experience. There weren't many patients when I went, so I was able to get treated right away. If anyone needs dental work done, I highly recommend this clinic. It's rare to find a clinic with such a gentle dentist! I hope more people will use their services.
It hurts a lot. Using too much force is not good. It's not thorough.
The wisdom tooth extraction was quick and gentle; it was over in no time. There was some back pain after the anesthetic wore off, but it gradually improved. Six hours later, the pain is gone.
The doctor is very skilled and meticulous. I am very impressed. The price is not as expensive as I thought.
The technician had a very gentle touch; I didn't even feel anything after the tooth was extracted. It was a great first-time experience.
